en.page_title: About Bowei Xu - Business Systems Engineer in Texas
en.page_description: Bowei Xu is a business systems and backend engineer in College Station, Texas, with an M.S. in Computer Science and 3+ years building ERP, WMS, and MES systems.
en.intro_1: I'm Bowei Xu, a business systems and backend engineer based in College Station, Texas, with 3+ years of experience independently designing and shipping enterprise-grade business systems. At Fuel Cell Store I'm the sole developer behind the internal operations platform that runs the business: order management, warehouse operations (WMS), and shop-floor production execution (MES). It's a 50+ table database schema and 100,000+ line codebase translating real manufacturing and operations requirements into production software.
en.intro_2: I work end to end: database design, backend APIs, responsive interfaces, and the operational dashboards that tie them together. I lean on modern AI-assisted development workflows to ship faster without giving up engineering judgment or code review.
en.looking_body: Open to backend, platform, and full-stack engineering roles. I'm at my best owning systems end to end and turning messy operational problems into reliable software.
en.edu_1_detail: M.S. in Computer Science · Los Angeles, CA · 2020-2022
en.edu_2_detail: B.Eng. in Computer Science and Technology · Kaifeng, China · 2016-2020
en.beyond_body: Outside of work I'm a competitive Go player: AGA 6-dan, Chinese 5-dan, two-time champion of the Houston Go Tournament, and a certified national referee (China, Level 2). In 2023 I ranked 2nd in the U.S. among players with ten or more AGA-rated games, at 13 wins and 1 loss.

en.beyond_photo_caption: Prize ceremony at the Fall 2023 Houston Go Tournament, where I took the Overall (High Dan) title. I'm third from the right.

zh.page_title: 关于徐博伟 - 德州业务系统工程师
zh.page_description: 徐博伟是常驻德克萨斯州 College Station 的业务系统与后端工程师，计算机科学硕士，拥有 3 年以上 ERP、WMS、MES 系统开发经验。
zh.intro_1: 我是徐博伟，一名常驻美国德州 College Station 的业务系统与后端工程师，拥有 3 年以上独立设计并交付企业级业务系统的经验。在 Fuel Cell Store，我作为唯一开发者从零搭建了支撑公司日常运转的内部运营平台，覆盖订单管理、仓储作业（WMS）与车间生产执行（MES）。50+ 张表的数据库架构、10 万行以上代码，将真实的制造与运营需求转化为生产级软件。
zh.intro_2: 我能端到端地完成工作：数据库设计、后端 API、响应式界面，以及把它们串联起来的运营看板。我借助现代 AI 辅助开发流程更快交付，同时不放弃工程判断与代码审查。
zh.looking_body: 正在寻找后端、平台与全栈软件工程师的机会。我最擅长端到端地负责整个系统，把繁杂的运营问题转化为可靠的软件。
zh.edu_1_detail: 计算机科学硕士 · 洛杉矶，加州 · 2020-2022
zh.edu_2_detail: 计算机科学与技术 工学学士 · 开封，中国 · 2016-2020
zh.beyond_body: 工作之外，我是一名竞技围棋手：AGA 6 段、中国 5 段，两度夺得休斯顿围棋公开赛冠军，并持有中国国家二级裁判员资格。2023 年在全年参加 10 局以上 AGA 评级对局的美国棋手中排名全美第 2，战绩 13 胜 1 负。
